children: Rosenblatt maintained their Buy rating on Penguin Solutions's stock with a price target of $100.00.
The price target implies an upside of 55.7% from the Oct 6 close of $64.21.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: Penguin Solutions has significantly raised its FY27 revenue guidance to approximately $2.43 billion, reflecting a robust 40% year-over-year growth driven by strong bookings in AI infrastructure and Integrated Memory segments. This upward revision showcases the company's ability to capitalize on increasing demand for AI-related hardware and infrastructure.

: The company's Non-GAAP gross margin is expected to rise to 28% with an operating margin estimate increasing to 17.6%. This improvement in profitability, primarily driven by better-than-expected memory pricing and operational efficiencies, reinforces investor confidence in Penguin Solutions' financial health and operational execution.
Across the three most recent analyst notes published on PENG over the past 30 days, price targets range from $80 to $85.
